summary: This note is a short biography of Nicholas Baptiste, a Canadian professional ice hockey forward. It states his birth date, that he is currently an unrestricted free agent, and that his most recent team was the Toronto Marlies of the AHL as a prospect of the Toronto Maple Leafs. It also notes he was drafted by the Buffalo Sabres in the 2013 NHL Entry Draft.
one_line: Canadian ice hockey forward, a former Toronto Marlies prospect and 2013 Buffalo Sabres draft pick, now an unrestricted free agent.
key_facts: Nicholas Baptiste was born on August 4, 1995.
Nicholas Baptiste is a Canadian professional ice hockey forward.
Nicholas Baptiste is currently an unrestricted free agent.
Nicholas Baptiste most recently played for the Toronto Marlies in the American Hockey League (AHL).
Nicholas Baptiste played as a prospect to the Toronto Maple Leafs of the National Hockey League (NHL).
Nicholas Baptiste was drafted by the Buffalo Sabres.
Nicholas Baptiste was selected in the third round, 69th overall, of the 2013 NHL Entry Draft.
